# v2026.11.19

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.19.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.19.md).

This release covers **6 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- An owner or admin can tick "Approve in Xero and email each client" when they send. The dialog shows each client's Xero email address and the total before they confirm. ([#556](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/556))
- A send to Xero that fails goes back to Pending, never Void. An invoice that never reached Xero can be deleted; its job and other links are kept. ([#556](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/556))
- The Jobs board shows Flow lanes: Invoiced, Paid and a folded Done. ([#543](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/543))
- The Invoices page loads about 4 times faster. ([#554](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/554))

## Changes

- Approve and email from the send dialog, for owners and admins only. A client with no email in Xero goes as a draft. Flow reads the client's email in Xero again right before each email request and holds the email when it changed. ([#556](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/556))
- An issued or void invoice that never reached Xero can be deleted. "Use Xero invoice" deletes Flow's copy when it never reached Xero. ([#556](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/556))
- The Jobs board shows Flow lanes with Invoiced, Paid and a folded Done. ([#543](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/543))

## Fixes

- A history job that a rule released is never drafted again. ([#555](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/555))
- A new mapping also reaches a released history job. ([#552](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/552))
- The Invoices page loads about 4 times faster, and the error report button works behind ad blockers. ([#554](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/554))
